# The Shape Underneath {#sec-conclusion}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "I need to learn a framework" — everything in the package was
one call plus plain Python, and now the reader can see which parts of
any AI product are the model and which are the harness.

Closes: the five-part shape (call, ground, act, control, sense);
the exit map to production tools; the argument that understanding the
machine is what makes supervising AI possible. Points to Appendix D
and to *Ship Python, Orchestrate AI* for the professional road.
:::
